primary.title: An Autobiography or The Story of My Experiments with Truth
primary.author: Mahatma Gandhi
primary.rationale: Gandhi's autobiography is a foundational primary source for understanding his life, philosophy, and political activities. It is widely available.

primary.title: Hind Swaraj or Indian Home Rule
primary.author: Mahatma Gandhi
primary.rationale: This seminal work outlines Gandhi's vision for India's independence and his critique of Western civilization. It is a key text for his political thought.

primary.title: The Collected Works of Mahatma Gandhi
primary.author: Mahatma Gandhi
primary.rationale: This multi-volume collection contains a vast array of Gandhi's writings, speeches, and letters, offering unparalleled depth for research. While the full collection might be extensive, individual volumes or selections are often digitized.

secondary.title: Gandhi: A Political and Spiritual Biography
secondary.author: Judith M. Brown
secondary.rationale: Judith Brown is a respected historian of modern India, and this biography offers a comprehensive and scholarly analysis of Gandhi's life and impact.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Gandhi
secondary.author: Judith M. Brown
secondary.rationale: This collection of essays by leading scholars provides diverse perspectives on Gandhi's life, thought, and legacy, covering various aspects of his influence.

secondary.title: Gandhi and the Modern World: A Reader's Guide
secondary.author: Peter Brock
secondary.rationale: While slightly before the 1976 cutoff, this work is a significant scholarly guide to understanding Gandhi's ideas and their relevance in the modern context, often cited in academic research.

suggestions.notes: The 'Collected Works' is a massive undertaking; specific volumes or selections are more likely to be found in digital archives than the entire set.
